# @ndigo/http

Fetch-based HTTP client, interceptors, and content parsing for Ndigo

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Subpaths

- `@ndigo/http/transformers`

## Public exports

- `HTTPMethod` *(type)* — The HTTP request methods the framework routes and dispatches, including `QUERY` — the safe, idempotent body-carrying method.
- `HTTPInit` *(type)* — Base request settings shared by HTTP client methods and interceptor hooks.
- `HTTPConfig` *(type)* — Configuration options for creating an HTTP client instance via HTTP.create.
- `Fetch` *(type)* — Fetch implementation signature used by HTTP.
- `CompletionAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Runs after a request finishes, whether it succeeded or failed.
- `ErrorAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Handles failures that occur while executing a request.
- `InitializationAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Allows a request to be rejected before it is initialized.
- `RequestAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Allows a request object to be replaced before fetch executes.
- `ResponseAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Allows a response to be replaced after fetch completes.
- `HTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Supported HTTP interceptors recognized by HTTP.
- `HTTPAware` *(type)* — Describes objects that can receive an HTTP instance.
- `likeCompletionAwareHTTPInterceptor` — Tests whether a value exposes \`postComplete()\`.
- `likeErrorAwareHTTPInterceptor` — Tests whether a value exposes \`postError()\`.
- `likeInitializationAwareHTTPInterceptor` — Tests whether a value exposes \`preInit()\`.
- `likeRequestAwareHTTPInterceptor` — Tests whether a value exposes \`preRequest()\`.
- `likeResponseAwareHTTPInterceptor` — Tests whether a value exposes \`postResponse()\`.
- `likeHTTPInterceptor` — Tests whether a value behaves like any supported HTTP interceptor.

- `freeze`

- `isRequest`

- `HTTPExecutionChain` — Ordered interceptor chain for one `HTTP` client: tracks which interceptor capabilities are registered (completion/error/initialization/request/response aware)…
- `HTTP` — HTTP client with interceptor support and convenience verb helpers.
- `HeaderRecord` *(type)* — Node `IncomingMessage`-style header record (lower-cased name → value or lines).
- `foldHeaderName` — Folds a header name to the lower-cased spelling used by Node server header records (DSG-5).
- `HTTPHeader` — Represents a single HTTP header name with helpers for common header collections.
- `AuthorizationHeader` — Authorization header category: credential-scheme parsing on the constant itself.
- `MULTIPART_FORM_DATA` — The recognized multipart media type (canonical base-type string; single source is `@ndigo/core`'s `MediaTypes.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA`).
- `contentTypeBase` — Extracts the bare media type from a `Content-Type` header value: the part before the first `;`, trimmed and lower-cased. `null` when the header is absent or bl…
- `multipartBoundary` — Extracts the multipart boundary from a `Content-Type` value, or `null`. The media type must be `multipart/form-data`; the `boundary` parameter name is matched…
- `ContentTypeHeader` — Content-Type header category: value parsing on the constant itself.
- `SetCookieHeader` — Set-Cookie header category: value construction on the constant itself.
- `AppResetInit` *(type)* — Extends HTTP initialization with app-reset response handling options.
- `AppResetInterceptor` — HTTP interceptor that reloads the page when a matching reset response is received.
- `CacheInterceptorConfig` *(type)* — Configuration options for the CacheInterceptor.
- `CacheInterceptor` — HTTP interceptor that provides in-memory response caching.
- `ContentTypeInit` *(type)* — Request settings for ContentTypeInterceptor.
- `ContentTypeInterceptor` — Adds a `Content-Type` header when request settings provide one.
- `DataInit` *(type)* — Body value accepted by DataParameterInterceptor.
- `DataParameterInit` *(type)* — Request settings for DataParameterInterceptor.
- `DataParameterInterceptor` — Moves `data` into the URL for bodyless methods and into `body` otherwise.
- `ErrorNormalizationInterceptorConfig` *(type)* — Configuration options for the ErrorNormalizationInterceptor.
- `ErrorNormalizationInterceptor` — HTTP interceptor that standardizes error responses into a consistent shape.
- `HeaderInterceptorConfig` *(type)* — Configuration options for the HeaderInterceptor.
- `HeaderInterceptor` — HTTP interceptor that adds standard headers to outgoing requests.
- `IfModifiedInit` *(type)* — Request settings for IfModifiedInterceptor.
- `IfModifiedInterceptor` — Adds conditional request headers and caches validators from prior responses.
- `NotOKInterceptor` — Throws a ResponseError when the response status is outside 200-299.
- `InformationAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Handles informational responses.
- `SuccessAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Handles successful responses.
- `RedirectAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Handles redirect responses.
- `ClientErrorAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Handles client error responses.
- `ServerErrorAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Handles server error responses.
- `ResponseClassAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Union of all response-class-specific interceptor roles.
- `likeInformationAwareHTTPInterceptor` — Tests whether a value exposes `postInformationalResponse()`.
- `likeSuccessAwareHTTPInterceptor` — Tests whether a value exposes `postSuccessfulResponse()`.
- `likeRedirectAwareHTTPInterceptor` — Tests whether a value exposes `postRedirectResponse()`.
- `likeClientErrorAwareHTTPInterceptor` — Tests whether a value exposes `postClientErrorResponse()`.
- `likeServerErrorAwareHTTPInterceptor` — Tests whether a value exposes `postServerErrorResponse()`.
- `MappedResponseClassHTTPInterceptor` — Dispatches response hooks based on the response status class.
- `ResponseCodeAwareHTTPInterceptor` *(type)* — Hooks keyed by exact HTTP status code.
- `MappedResponseCodeHTTPInterceptor` — Dispatches response hooks based on the numeric status code.
- `ResponseBodyParser` *(type)* — Resolved parser that reads a response body into typed data.
- `ResponseParser` *(type)* — Factory that produces a parser for a specific media type.
- `ResponseParserMap` *(type)* — Map of media types to response parsers.
- `ResponseParsers` *(type)* — Supported parser collections accepted by ResponseTypeInterceptor.
- `ResponseTypeInit` *(type)* — Request settings for ResponseTypeInterceptor.
- `ResponseTypeSettings` *(type)* — Normalized request settings used after initialization.
- `ResponseTypeInterceptor` — Parses response bodies into typed data and attaches the result as `data`.
- `RetryInit` *(type)* — Configuration options for the retry interceptor.
- `RetryInterceptor` — Retries failed HTTP requests up to a configurable limit.
- `StatusInterceptorConfig` *(type)* — Configuration options for the StatusInterceptor.
- `StatusInterceptor` — HTTP interceptor that normalizes HTTP status codes into consistent application-level status representations.
- `TimeoutInit` *(type)* — Request settings for TimeoutInterceptor.
- `TimeoutInterceptor` — Aborts slow requests and converts aborts into timeout responses.
- `TraceHeaderInterceptorOptions` *(type)* — Options for the TraceHeaderInterceptor.
- `TraceHeaderInterceptor` — HTTP interceptor that injects W3C `traceparent`/`tracestate` headers from the active trace context — the client half of distributed tracing.
- `TransformInterceptor` — Applies request and response body transforms at the interceptor boundary.
- `QueryString`
- `ResponseStatus`
- `ResponseStatuses`
- `TransformContext` *(type)* — Context information for conditional transformation logic.
- `HTTPTransformer` *(type)* — Contract for request/response body transformers.
- `Transform` *(type)* — User-provided transform function or transformer object.
- `JSONTransformer` — Applies a pipeline of transforms to JSON bodies.
- `CompositionTransformer` — Composes a sequence of body transforms into a single transformer.
- `FormDataEntryTransform` *(type)* — Transforms a single `FormData` entry.
- `FormDataTransformer` — Transforms `FormData` entries one by one while preserving multipart semantics.
- `URLSearchParamsEntryTransform` *(type)* — Transforms a single URLSearchParams entry.
- `URLSearchParamsTransformer` — Transforms `URLSearchParams` entries one by one.
